options.name: Frames Follow Camera
options.desc: Your character shows the facing seen by the camera and turns toward it.

options.name: Other Figures Turn With Camera
options.desc: Monsters, NPCs and other players show the side the camera sees.

options.name: Forward Follows Facing
options.desc: Forward walks the way you face; other movement keys follow from it.

options.name: Thin Solids' Depth
options.values: thin=Thin (6 px);half=Half a Cell;full=A Full Cell

options.name: Block Sides
options.values: mirrored=Mirrored from the Picture;edge=Edge Pixels Carried Round

options.name: Figure Thickness
options.desc: Flat figures and the items on the ground keep a few pixels' depth, so seen from the side they show as a thin cut-out instead of a line.

options.name: Shadows
options.values: cast=Cast by the Sun;painted=Painted on the Ground

options.name: Finer Height Near the Camera
options.desc: Builds the small bumps a tile's hint gives the ground on a grid four times finer near the camera, so they follow the art more closely (the new graphics engine).

options.name: Normal Maps from the Art
options.desc: Lets the light pick out the relief in the ground's and objects' art, pixel by pixel, worked out from the art's own light and dark: the gaps between cobbles and the mortar between bricks lie lower (the new graphics engine).

options.name: View Distance
options.desc: Controls the view distance in 3D modes.

options.name: Fade Out
options.desc: Makes tiles fade out this far past the view distance.

options.name: Horizon From the Map (%)
options.desc: How strongly the land past the map's edge shapes the horizon, from 0 (the plain sky) to 100 (with the new graphics engine, how strongly its mountains show).

options.name: Cloud Ring Past the Map
options.desc: Ends the map a short way past its edge in a ring of stylised clouds at ground level, standing in a soft mist that runs out to the skybox's mountains (the new graphics engine).

options.name: Layered Cloud Ring
options.desc: The cloud ring in layers: a few kinds and sizes of cloud with bigger ones among them, the back rows higher, gently bobbing in a thick ground mist. Off: three rows of one kind (the new graphics engine).

options.name: Cloud Ring Distance (tiles)
options.desc: How far past the map's edge the cloud ring's first clouds stand; the ground past the edge shows up to them (the new graphics engine).

options.name: Skybox Distance (tiles)
options.desc: How far past the map's edge the skybox's nearest mountains stand, behind the cloud ring and its mist; the farther ranges stand behind them. Lower brings them nearer and bigger (the new graphics engine, in 3D with the cloud ring on).

options.name: Mountain Distance (tiles)
options.desc: How far behind the skybox's nearest hills its next range stands; its far mountains stand about three times as far again (the new graphics engine, in 3D with the cloud ring on).

options.name: Mountain Height (%)
options.desc: How tall the skybox's hills and mountains stand (the new graphics engine).

options.name: Rainbow
options.desc: A rainbow opposite the sun as the rain's clouds clear after it, while the sun is low enough to show one (with Advanced Weather; the new graphics engine).

options.name: Aurora
options.desc: Now and then on clear nights, northern lights in the north of the sky over maps whose land past the edge is snowy (the new graphics engine).
